name: Voice ~Kimi ni Tsuzuku Oto~
source:
Who am I making music for?

"Ah~"

A crystal clear voice resounds in my ears.
This... sounds good, I think. Maybe.

I first learned about Vocaloid from reading an article I happened upon in a magazine once.
To take part in a music contest, I decided to buy KAITO.
It's gonna be fine if I can manipulate his voice well...
I installed him without dwelling much more on it.

But I couldn't have possibly predicted this...

[Translated from [url=http://master.is-mine.net/nicot/game/voice_arasuji.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
我在为谁创作音乐？

“啊～”

水晶般清澈的声音在耳边回响。这个……听起来不错，也许吧。

我第一次从杂志文章里了解到VOCALOID。为了参加音乐比赛，我决定购买KAITO。只要能顺利操纵他的声音，应该就没问题……我没再多想，便安装了他。

可是，我怎么也没想到会发生这种事……

[译自[url=http://master.is-mine.net/nicot/game/voice_arasuji.html]官方网站[/url]]
